job.title: Residential Youth Worker - Rockhampton
job.description:
Who Are We?
 Ready to make a difference? HCA Youth & Community has connected exceptional youth and support workers with rewarding opportunities across Australia for over 30 years. Join a team that values compassion, resilience and connection, with flexible work and the support you need to thrive. 

At HCA, we pride ourselves on creating a positive and rewarding work environment where our staff feel supported, valued, and empowered to make a genuine impact in the community.

Employee Benefits:
  • Flexible Scheduling – Control your work-life balance via our app
  • Weekly Pay – Get paid weekly to help manage your budget
  • Competitive Hourly Rate – $46.76- $84.11 (incl. penalty rates)
  • 24/7 Service Team – Dedicated coordinators available anytime
  • Ongoing Support – Supervision plus access to EAP support
 Fuel, Flex & Flourish
  • Fuel – Discounted meals and meal kits from YouFoodz and EveryPlate delivered to your door.
  • Flex – Affordable gym and pool access across Australia with Fitness Passport.
  • Flourish – Free 24/7 mental wellbeing support through the PsychHealth app.
Position Overview:
As a Casual Residential Youth Worker, you’ll play a vital role in supporting children and young people living in out-of-home care. You’ll help create a safe, stable, and nurturing environment while supporting young people to build life skills, resilience, and positive connections. With rosters planned in advance, you’ll enjoy flexibility and greater work-life balance, with opportunities for consistent ongoing shifts as well as emergency and ad hoc work.

Responsibilities:
  • Build positive, trusting relationships with children and young people
  • Create a safe, supportive, and trauma-informed environment
  • Support daily living tasks including meals, personal care, hygiene, and routines
  • Encourage independence, emotional regulation, and social development
  • Assist with school attendance, appointments, and community participation
  • Administer medication and maintain accurate case notes/documentation
  • Support complex behaviours using trauma-informed practices and TCI strategies
  • Work collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams and care plans
  • Participate in ongoing training, supervision, and reflective practice

We’re Looking For
To be considered for this Youth Worker role, you’ll need to have (or be open to obtaining) the following:
  • Hold (or be studying towards) a Certificate IV in Youth Work, Child, Youth and Family Intervention, Social Work, Disability Support Work or similar Community Services industry
  • Australian Drivers License (OPEN)
    Working with Children Check (Blue Card)
  • Current First Aid & CPR certificate
  • Police Check
HCA Community Staffing Solutions is an employer of equal opportunity and encourages CALD, LGBTQIA+ and First Nations people to apply

job.title: Disabilty Support Work - Toowoomba
job.description:
Who Are We? - HCA Youth & Community is one of Australia’s leading community staffing providers, with over 30 years of experience connecting exceptional people with meaningful work across children, youth, disability, aged care and mental health services.
We offer flexible, rewarding opportunities in a supportive environment where compassion, connection and making a genuine difference matter.

Position Overview — More Than a Shift. A Chance to Make a Difference. In partnership with Dynamic Community Care (DCC) As a casual Disability Support Worker with HCA, you can make a real difference in the lives of people who are living with a disability in residential, community access, and supported independent living. Working with some of Australia’s best disability service providers, every day grants you a unique experience and adventure, empowering people to live their best lives, and achieve their goals. and make a positive impact.

Why HCA?
  • Emergency and ad hoc shifts available each week, with the potential to transition to rosters provided in advance
  • A supportive team that has your back
  • Meaningful work where every shift matters

Key Duties and Responsibilities:
  • Assist with daily living and personal care for individuals with disabilities.
  • Create a supportive environment that promotes independence and inclusion.
  • Help with light housekeeping, meal prep, and accessing community resources.
  • Administer medication, monitor health, and keep accurate records.
  • Communicate effectively with clients, families, and care teams.
  • Respond to emergencies, uphold confidentiality, and provide emotional support.
What You Need:
✅ Hold an Australian Certificate III or higher in Disabilities, Community Services, Individual Support, Mental Health or similar
✅ Qld Drivers License (P1 or higher)
✅ Comprehensive Car insurance and Car Registration
✅ NDIS Worker Check (Yellow Card)
✅ Working with Children Check (Blue Card)
✅ Current First Aid & CPR certificate
✅ National Police Check
✅ Medications and Manual handling experience preferred
✅ 3 month minimum experience in the industry preferred 
✅ The ability to work a mixture of day, night and weekend shifts as required


HCA is an equal opportunity employer and encourages CALD, LGBTQIA+ and First Nations people to apply.

job.title: Residential Youth Worker - Yeppoon
job.description:
Who Are We?
Edmen Community Staffing Solutions are one of Australia's leading providers of community service workers. For over 30 years, we've connected exceptional talent with organisations in child protection, disability, aged care, and mental health. We offer expert staffing solutions and outstanding employee experiences. We're dedicated to providing a supportive and rewarding work environment.

Employee Benefits: Fuel, Flex & Flourish
  • Fuel - Healthy eating made easier: Enjoy discounted meals and meal kits from YouFoodz and EveryPlate, delivered fresh to your door. Perfect for busy weeks and shift work.
  • Flex - Move your way: We've partnered with Fitness Passport to give you low-cost access to gyms and pools across Australia.
  • Flourish - Mental wellbeing, when you need it: Access the PsychHealth app for free, with 24/7 tools to support your emotional wellbeing.
Position Overview:
As a casual Residential Youth Worker with Edmen, you'll play a meaningful role supporting children and young people in out-of-home care. We're looking for compassionate, resilient individuals who can respond to complex behaviours—including physical and non-verbal communication—often linked to trauma, neurodiversity, and disrupted attachment. Enjoy the flexibility of casual work with the added benefit of advance rostering for greater stability, plus access to emergency and ad hoc shifts each week. Competitive hourly rates range from $44.61 to $80.30, depending on penalty rates.

Key Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Create safety, stability and predictability: Build a safe, trusting relationship with young people and foster a secure, nurturing environment for at-risk youth.
  • Empower Daily Living: Assist with personal care, meals, and hygiene to promote independence.
  • Facilitate Transportation: Ensure young people attend school, appointments, and community activities.
  • Promote Growth: Promote emotional regulation and social connection through structured and unstructured activities. 
  • Manage Health Needs: Administer medications and maintain accurate reporting.
  • Deliver Trauma-Informed Care: Support youth with complex behaviours using trauma-informed approaches and respond to behaviours with empathy, consistency, using a TCI model approach.
  • Engage in Therapeutic Practices: Participate in the Trauma Recovery framework and complete Therapeutic Crisis Intervention (TCI) within your first three months.
  • Communication: Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to develop individualised support plans
  • Wellbeing: Maintain personal wellbeing and resilience through reflective practice, supervision and self-care strategies
What You Need:
✅ Hold (or be studying towards) a Certificate IV in Youth Work, Child, Youth and Family Intervention, Social Work, Disability Support Work or similar (see full list of accepted qualifications on our website)
✅ Australian Drivers License (P2 or higher)
✅ Working with Children Check (Blue Card)
✅ Current First Aid & CPR certificate
✅ The ability to work a mixture of day, night and weekend shifts as required
✅ Has or is willing to obtain the following certifications:

  • Current First Aid & CPR certificate
  • Hope and Healing 10 certificate
  • LCS Personal History Screening
Desirable:
✅ Experience working with children or youth with complex behaviours
✅ Understanding of trauma informed care
✅ Skills in de-escalating emotional containment and relational repair
✅ Understanding around behaviour as a form of communication and how to respond

Edmen Community Staffing Solutions is an employer of equal opportunity and encourages CALD, LGBTQIA+ and First Nations people to apply.

job.title: Residential Youth Worker - North Brisbane
job.description:
Who Are We? 
HCA Youth and Community are one of Australia’s leading providers of community service workers across the nation!  

We are absolutely delighted to partner with Infinity Community Solutions, a purpose-driven organisation providing tailored support services that empower individuals, families, and communities to live independent, fulfilling lives.  
 
Position Overview: 
As a casual Residential Youth Worker with HCA, you can make a real difference in the lives of children and young people who are living in out-of-home care. We are seeking compassionate and resilient youth workers to support children from a wide range of backgrounds. 

As a Youth Worker at Infinity you will be joining a welcoming and supportive team. To make life a little easier for you, we do our rosters in advance, which grants you some stability working in a casual environment. We also have emergency and ad hoc shifts available each week. 
 
Responsibilities: 
  • Build trusting relationships and create a safe, nurturing environment for at-risk youth.

  • Support attendance at school, appointments, and community activities. 
  • Encourage emotional regulation and social connection through daily activities. 
  • Administer medication and maintain accurate records.

  • Work with multidisciplinary teams on individual support plans.

  • Hold (or be studying towards) a Certificate IV in Youth Work, Child, Youth and Family Intervention, Social Work, Disability Support Work or similar

job.title: Permanent Part Time Residential Youth Worker
job.description:
Who We Are
HCA Youth and Community Services is one of Australia's leading community service providers, connecting skilled workers with organisations in child protection, disability, aged care, and mental health for over 30 years. We're committed to meaningful work and supportive employment experiences.

Position Overview
As a Permanent Part-Time Residential Youth Worker with HCA, you'll support children and young people living in out-of-home care in a meaningful, trauma-informed role. We're seeking compassionate, resilient individuals who can confidently respond to complex behaviours while creating safe, supportive environments where young people can thrive.

This opportunity is ideal for those looking for greater stability and consistency in their work. You'll enjoy a guaranteed minimum number of hours each fortnight, more predictable rosters, and the opportunity to build stronger relationships by working consistently with the same teams, houses, and young people.

Your employment will commence on a 12-month fixed-term permanent part-time contract, with the opportunity to transition into an ongoing permanent position at the end of the contract, subject to performance and operational requirements.

What's on Offer
Guaranteed minimum number of working hours per fortnight, with rosters that are typically consistent each week.
  • Competitive hourly rates ranging from $37.38 to $74.76, depending on the shift worked, with applicable penalty rates included.
  • Paid annual leave and personal (sick) leave.
  • Superannuation contributions.
  • Greater job security through permanent part-time employment.
  • More consistent rostering, allowing for greater placement continuity with the same houses, teams, and young people.
  • Ongoing support from a dedicated consultant and access to professional development opportunities.
Key Duties
  • Build safe, trusting relationships with young people.
  • Support daily living activities including meals, personal hygiene, routines, and independent living skills.
  • Transport young people to school, appointments, family contact, and recreational activities.
  • Promote emotional regulation, resilience, and positive social engagement.
  • Administer medication and maintain accurate case notes and documentation.
  • Respond to challenging behaviours using trauma-informed and TCI-informed approaches.
  • Work collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams and key stakeholders.
  • Maintain professional boundaries, reflective practice, and personal wellbeing.
What You Need
  • Availability to work overnight shifts (minimum three per week, 2:30 pm–9:00 am sleepover) – this is essential.
    Certificate IV in Youth Work, Community Services, Child, Youth and Family Intervention, or an equivalent qualification.

job.title: Trauma Informed Residential Youth Worker - Toowoomba
job.description:
Who Are We?
HCA Youth are one of Australia’s leading providers of community service workers. For over 30 years, we've connected exceptional talent with organisations in child protection, disability, aged care, and mental health..
  
HCA Youth are proudly partnering with Dynamic Community Care (DCC) to provide workforce solutions to a thriving youth organisation. DCC offers round-the-clock care to young people in different settings, such as residential, community access, outreach and supervised family contact, and if you have a caring heart, a sense of adventure, and a passion to change young lives, we'd love to have you join us.We offer expert staffing solutions and outstanding employee experiences. We're dedicated to providing a supportive and rewarding work environment.

What We Bring to the Table:
  • Flexible Scheduling: Control your work-life balance with our app.
  • Weekly Pay: Manage your budget with regular weekly payments.
  • Competitive Hourly Rate: $44.61 - $80.30, based on penalty rates
  • 24/7 Servicing Team: Dedicated service coordinators available anytime.
  • Ongoing Support: Access supervision and our Employee Assistance Program (EAP).
  • Employee Benefits: Fuel, Flex & Flourish 
    • Fuel - Healthy eating made easier: Enjoy discounted meals and meal kits from YouFoodz and EveryPlate, delivered fresh to your door. Perfect for busy weeks and shift work.
    • Flex - Move your way: We've partnered with Fitness Passport to give you low-cost access to gyms and pools across Australia.
    • Flourish - Mental wellbeing, when you need it: Access the PsychHealth app for free, with 24/7 tools to support your emotional wellbeing.
Position Overview:
As a casual Residential Youth Worker with HCA Youth, you can make a real difference in the lives of children and young people who are living in out-of-home care. We are seeking a compassionate and resilient team of youth workers who are able to support children who express their needs through physical behaviours, including non-verbal communication and protective responses. These behaviours are often due to experiences of childhood trauma, neurodiversity and disrupted attachment.

Our rosters are done in advance, which grants you some stability working in a casual environment. We also have emergency and ad hoc shifts available each week.

Key Duties and Responsibilities:
  • Create safety, stability and predictability: Build a safe, trusting relationship with young people and foster a secure, nurturing environment for at-risk youth.
  • Empower Daily Living: Assist with personal care, meals, and hygiene to promote independence.
  • Facilitate Transportation: Ensure young people attend school, appointments, and community activities.
  • Promote Growth: Promote emotional regulation and social connection through structured and unstructured activities. 
  • Manage Health Needs: Administer medications and maintain accurate reporting.
  • Deliver Trauma-Informed Care: Support youth with complex behaviours using trauma-informed approaches and respond to behaviours with empathy, consistency, using a TCI model approach.
  • Engage in Therapeutic Practices: Participate in the Trauma Recovery framework and complete Therapeutic Crisis Intervention (TCI) within your first six months.
  • Communication: Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to develop individualised support plans
  • Wellbeing: Maintain personal wellbeing and resilience through reflective practice, supervision and self-care strategies
What You Need:
✅ Hold a certificate IV in Youth Work, Child, Youth and Family Intervention, Community Services, or equivalent
✅ A minimum of 3 months experience in Residential Youth Services, or industry-relevant transferable skills
✅ Demonstrated experience in supporting trauma-related challenging behaviours
✅ Hold an Australian Drivers Licence (QLD Opens)
✅ Possess a Working With Children Check (Blue Card)
✅ Can provide availability to work across AM/PM/Active night shifts 
✅ Has or is willing to obtain the following certifications:
  • Current First Aid & CPR certificate
  • LCS Personal History Screening
  • Hope and Healing 10 training
Desirable:
✅ Experience working with children or youth with complex behaviours
✅ Understanding of trauma informed care
✅ Skills in de-escalating emotional containment and relational repair
✅ Understanding around behaviour as a form of communication and how to respond

HCA Youth is an employer of equal opportunity and encourages CALD, LGBTQIA+ and First Nations people to apply.
